title: Syringe-Filter Based DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Sungwoo Bae
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ysqfwdw
materials: Prepare the following solutions a. TE buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl and 1 mM EDTA) b. TE/lysozyme (TL) buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, 1 mM EDTA, and 7.5 mg/mL lysozyme) c. TE/proteinase K/SDS (TPS) buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, 1 mM EDTA, 300 µg/mL proteinase K, and 1% SDS[w/v])
Magnetic beads addition A 50 µL of silica-coated magnetic beads solution (Dynabeads MyOne SILANE, Invitrogen) was added to the flow-through and was mixed by inversions for 5mins.

steps.title: Filter sample through syringe filter
steps.instruction: Pass the 10 mL (or 100 mL) sample through a 0.2 µm pore‑sized syringe filter in the direction of filtration.

steps.title: Add TE buffer and collect filtrate
steps.instruction: Inject 1 mL TE buffer into the same filter (same direction) and pool the flow‑through into a sterile 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Backwash filter in reverse direction
steps.instruction: Perform backwashing in the opposite direction, mixing by inversion for 5 min between each sub‑step, and pool all flow‑through into the same 15 mL tube. Discard the filter after backwashing.

substeps.instruction: Flush 1 mL TL buffer through the filter, then add 300 µL TL to the pooled flow‑through.
Flush 1 mL TPS buffer through the filter.
Flush 1 mL TPS buffer followed by three 1 mL air plugs through the filter; mix the resulting flow‑through.

steps.title: Optional bead washing
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL washing buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA pH 8.0, 70 % ethanol) to the beads, pipette‑mix several times, magnetize beads to tube walls, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Elute DNA and dilute
steps.instruction: Elute DNA from the beads, collect the eluate, and dilute for storage.

substeps.instruction: Flush 50 µL TE buffer through the beads to elute DNA.
Collect magnetic beads and recover the DNA eluate.
Dilute the recovered DNA 3‑fold with TE buffer; store at –20 °C if desired.
